_readme: deu slice (#468) additions, same shape as patterns.json. Each kp is pre-fix text from ops/deu-435 or a still-live deu_for_eng row. Target-side 'deu' regexes run on deu_for_eng, deu_at_for_eng and deu_ch_for_eng (dialect courses: they rarely match standard-German forms, which is expected). Two-sided rules (want|möchte, könnte|konnte K45, yet|noch/schon K46, sir/madam K32, basket-drills-its-LEGO P17) cannot be one regex; they were run as a separate read of the dumps: reports/deu-checks/*.py.
